en: Black-and-white postcard view of a modest brick railway station building with the large rooftop sign "NYKÖPINGS SÖDRA". Several people, including children, stand or walk in front of the entrance; bicycles are parked nearby. Trees frame the image and open countryside or water is visible in the background. In the lower left corner the caption reads "NYKÖPING. Södra Stationen" and a small publisher's logo with number appears in the lower right.
